why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Added the credit history section under the credit balance on the Settings page displaying timestamp, localized activity label, refund badge for refunds, and signed credit amount in both English and Korean.

+import uuid

+from tests.conftest import signup

+
+
+def _get_workspace_id(client, headers):
+    workspaces = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()
+    return workspaces[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_includes_daily_refill_charges_and_refunds_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ws_id = _get_workspace_id(client, h)
+
+    # Trigger daily refill (+50)
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    # Create a project and trigger a failed cover generation (charge -15, then refund +15)
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Cover Test", "genres": []}).json()
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    # Trigger a successful cover generation (charge -15)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+
+    # Expected transactions: daily_refill (+50), charge (-15), refund (+15), charge (-15)
+    assert len(items) == 4
+    for item in items:
+        assert set(item.keys()) == {"amount", "action", "created_at"}
+
+    # Newest first
+    timestamps = [item["created_at"] for item in items]
+    assert timestamps == sorted(timestamps, reverse=True)
+
+    amounts_and_actions = [(item["amount"], item["action"]) for item in items]
+    assert (50, "daily_refill") in amounts_and_actions
+    assert amounts_and_actions.count((-15, "generate_project_cover_image")) == 2
+    assert (15, "refund:generate_project_cover_image") in amounts_and_actions
+
+

+
+    # Unauthenticated
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history").status_code == 401
+
+    # Non-member sees 404
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{ws_id}/credits/history", headers=other_h)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+
+    # Non-existent workspace sees 404
+    r = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=owner_h)
